newsitem.title: ITALY: Prospective Italian bourse manager raises capital.
newsitem.headline: Prospective Italian bourse manager raises capital.

text.p: Borsa Italiana Spa, the private company being set up to run Italy's stock market, has raised its capital to two billion lire from 200 million, a statement from the stock exchange council said.
The amount corresponds to assets carried over from the bourse council, which Borsa Italiana is due to replace in the running of the financial markets.
The statement said after the capital increase, which would conclude ahead of schedule, the placement of Borsa Italiana on the market could get underway.

Appraisals were underway which would allow the Italian Treasury to offer the shares for sale and market regulation proposals would then be put to the approval of stock market regulator Consob, it said.

Eventually, Borsa Italiana will be authorised to manage the financial markets in place of the stock market council, which is due to be dissolved but will continue to manage the markets in the interim.
